title: Spend Momentum Note (Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Spend-Milestone Bonus)
content:
**Note.** For a spend-milestone bonus on a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement, the milestone momentum is the spend of the spend entries posted in the momentum window — the 3 calendar months up to and including the credit date — as a percentage of the milestone year spend, which is the total of the spend entries posted to the agreement less the spend removed by its agreement-year reset entries. When the milestone year spend is zero, the momentum is taken against one dollar. The milestone momentum adds a momentum uplift:

| Milestone momentum | Momentum uplift |
|---|---|
| 40 percent or more | 10 percentage points |
| 25 percent or more, and below 40 | 5 percentage points |
| below 25 percent | nothing |

**How the uplift acts.** The uplift is counted in percentage points; milestone uplifts on different grounds are added together, and the milestone bonus is raised by the total: the milestone bonus before its allowance is the milestone bonus multiplied by one hundred plus the total uplift, divided by one hundred, rounded down to the whole point.

### Worked ratios (hypothetical)

| Spend posted in the 3-month window (USD) | Milestone year spend (USD) | Momentum | Uplift |
|---|---|---|---|
| 44000.00 | 110000.00 | 40 percent | 10 percentage points |
| 30000.00 | 110000.00 | about 27.3 percent | 5 percentage points |
| 27000.00 | 110000.00 | about 24.5 percent | nothing |
